what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan living in Ethiopia.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 422871 South Sudanese refugees in Ethiopia, 17.7% of all South Sudanese refugees.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021 and again in 2025, at war level in 2014.
The groups fighting the government include the SPLM/A - IO, which UCDP also lists in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Ethiopia rose from 58715 in 2012 to 422871 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025, after a big change between 2013 and 2014.
Returns from Ethiopia to South Sudan were highest in 2023 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Ethiopia only.
Ethiopia's share of all South Sudanese refugees was 67.5% in 2012 and 17.7% in 2025, as more people were counted in other countries.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Ethiopia they live.
